native_ceiling: Five drawings, exactly two words per physical line and eight canonical vessel clauses are teaching restrictions, not a native writer or a full natural language.
No Voynich noun, predicate, number, word meaning, homograph, sentence boundary or controller has been assigned.
Existing 77-group IT f75v passage is not covered by the unchanged two-word-per-line contract.
A coherent unknown-lexeme grammar may be authored without a confirmed word or another statistical permission test. Its compatibility alone does not select a meaning.
decision: Keep the source example. Do not build another inverse demonstrator or a native solver from it. Return to constructive whole-passage work only when an explicit shared construction can be authored without importing frozen glosses or silently changing controllers.
possible_minimal_native_obligation: The same written whole must allow two fixed analyses; an actually written shared construction must decide differently at two positions while the other words and claimed sentence boundaries remain explicit. This is a proposed obligation, not evidence that such a native pair exists.
